title: icomum subacaule
intro: Icomum subacaule, commonly known as Icomum, is a plant species that belongs to the Icacinaceae family. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may help to alleviate symptoms of fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Icomum subacaule include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as antipyretic, expectorant, and anti-inflammatory effects. The therapeutic actions of Icomum subacaule include its ability to reduce fever, relieve cough and respiratory congestion, and exhibit antimicrobial activity.
